descriptions.description: Alstroemeria ligtu is a species of flowering plant in the family Alstroemeriaceae, native to Peru, northwest Argentina and central Chile.
Lectotype (Bayer in Mitt. Bot. Staatssamml. Muenchen 24: 110. 1987): [icon] " Hemerocallis floribus purpurascentibus, striatis, vulgo Ligtu " in Feuillee, J. Obs. 2: 710, t. 4. 1714.
